title: vitis papillosa
intro: Vitis papillosa, commonly known as the Chinese grapevine, is a plant species in the Vitaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-boosting properties. The therapeutic actions of Vitis papillosa include pain relief, fever reduction, and wound healing, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and stilbenes. These constituents also contribute to the plant's ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anticancer properties, making it a valuable medicinal plant in traditional Chinese medicine.
